_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), series KLMNM SET-1, Q.P. Code 31/5/1. 32 pages (idx 0-31): idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-30, Hindi on every odd index 3-29 (each the Hindi of the page after it); odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet and at full size where a question spilled (idx 8 ends on Q11's OR, idx 10 opens with Q11(B) in English; idx 10/12 carry Q15's passage across the break): no English found on any odd page. idx 31 is blank apart from the footer. Questions run 1-39 unbroken. Sections are by DISCIPLINE as instruction (ii) prints: A Biology Q1-16 (30 marks), B Chemistry Q17-29 (25), C Physics Q30-39 (25); every question's printed marks match sci80_2026 exactly. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms pages 2-9) for a bare OR and confirming each on the paper: Q11 (A/B), Q15 (c) OR (c), Q16 (A/B), Q27 (A/B), Q28 (c) OR (c), Q29 (A/B), Q34 (A/B), Q38 (c) OR (c), Q39 (A/B) = 9 alternatives. Q14, Q35, Q36 and Q37 print parts (a)/(b) with no OR and stay one row each. Section-A, B and C MCQ keys are CBSE's own, read off the scheme as images (20 keyed MCQs: Q1-9, Q17-24, Q30-32; Q8, Q9, Q24 and Q32 are assertion-reason); no void, grace or dual key anywhere in the scheme. Case-study sub-part marks are not printed on the paper; they are taken from the scheme (Q15, Q28, Q38 all 1 + 1 + 2). Decimal points in Q33's table are ordinary full stops (2.25, 2.08). No reference papers given: nothing skipped.
